sn40.9:1.4: Idha bhikkhu sabbanimittānam amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhim upasampajja viharati ||
sn40.9:1.6: So kho ham āvuso sabbanimittānam amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhim upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn40.9:1.7: tassa mayham āvuso iminā vihārena viharato nimittānusariviññāṇaṃ hoti || || 6
sn40.9:2.1: Atha kho mam Bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etad avoca || ||
sn40.9:2.3: mā brāhmaṇa animittam cetosamādhim pamādo animitte cetosamādhismiṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi animitte cetosamādhismiṃ cittam ekodikarohi animitte cetosamādhismiṃ cittaṃ samādahā ti || || 7
sn40.9:2.4: So khvāhaṃ āvuso aparena samayena sabbanimittānam amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhim upasampajja vihāsiṃ || || 8
sn40.9:2.5: Yaṃ hi tam āvuso sammāvadamāno vadeyya ||
sn40.9:2.6: Satthārānuggahīto sāvako mahābhiññatam pattoti || mamaṃ taṃ sammāvadamāno vadeyya
sn40.9:2.7: Satthārānuggahīto sāvako mahābhiññatam patto ti || || 1 Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Mahā-
sn40.9:2.8: Moggalāno Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
